description: NaFeZr₂F₁₁ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent FeF₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.79 Å. Zr is bonded to seven F atoms to form ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramid, corners with three equivalent FeF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-33°. There are a spread of Zr-F bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.18 Å. Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form FeF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent NaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (2.06 Å) and four longer (2.14 Å) Fe-F bond lengths. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Fe atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Zr atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Zr and one Fe atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Zr atom.
